title: Customer Success - EMEA
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

This role is remote and can be executed across EMEA. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London or Warsaw.

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is a research and product company defining the frontier of Audio AI. Millions of individuals use ElevenLabs to read articles, voice over their videos, and reclaim voices lost from disability. And the leading developers and enterprises use ElevenLabs to create Conversational AI agents for support, sales, and education.

ElevenLabs launched in January 2023 with the first AI model to cross the threshold of human-like speech. In January 2025, we raised a $180 million Series C round, valuing ElevenLabs at $3.3 billion. The round was co-led by Andreessen Horowitz and ICONIQ Growth, with continued support from the leading names in tech, including Nat Friedman, Daniel Gross, Instagram co-founder Mike Krieger, Oculus VR co-founder Brendan Iribe, DeepMind and Inflection co-founder Mustafa Suleyman, and many others.

ElevenLabs is only 2 years old and scaling rapidly. We are just getting started. If you want to work hard and have an incredible impact, we would love to hear from you.

title: Principal Vehicle Integration Lead
description:
THE ROLE

Wayve is looking for an Vehicle Integration Lead to provide technical leadership for the electrical architecture, integration, validation, and delivery of our autonomous driving systems across vehicle platforms.

This role sits at the intersection of electrical and mechanical engineering, vehicle systems, autonomous driving hardware, software, and integration. You will lead the electrical integration of compute, sensing, power, communications, and supporting hardware into development and production-intent vehicles, ensuring systems perform reliably and safely in real-world environments.

You will work closely with Systems Engineering, Embedded Software, Autonomy, Safety, Vehicle Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, OEM partners, and external suppliers. You will provide technical direction while remaining close enough to the engineering to lead design decisions, troubleshoot complex integration issues, and drive programs through validation and vehicle readiness.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Lead the electrical architecture, mechanical design, and vehicle integration of Wayve's autonomous driving hardware across multiple development vehicle platforms.

- Own integration from early vehicle architecture and requirements through prototype builds, validation, production readiness, and deployment.

- Lead integration of:

- High-performance compute platforms

- Cameras and other perception sensors

- Radar, lidar, GNSS, IMUs, and supporting sensors

- Power distribution and power management systems

- ECUs and embedded electronic systems

- CAN, LIN, Automotive Ethernet, and other vehicle networks

- Wiring harnesses, connectors, and electrical interfaces

- Custom electronics and PCBAs

- Define system requirements, interfaces, architecture, and integration strategies for new vehicle platforms.

- Partner with software, systems, autonomy, OEMs, and assembly partners to ensure hardware and software interfaces are clearly defined and validated.

- Lead architecture and design reviews, making technical trade-offs across performance, reliability, safety, packaging, manufacturability, cost, and schedule.

- Drive vehicle-level integration, bring-up, commissioning, and validation.

- Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of complex integration issues across vehicles, hardware, and software.

- Develop verification and validation strategies to ensure systems meet performance, reliability, environmental, and safety requirements.

- Identify technical risks early and drive mitigation plans through development and vehicle launch.

- Partner with Functional Safety and Systems Engineering teams to ensure electrical architecture supports applicable safety requirements.

- Work directly with OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, contract manufacturers, upfitters, and integration partners to establish technical requirements and resolve integration challenges.

- Partner with Supply Chain and Manufacturing on component selection, supplier technical evaluations, production readiness, and engineering changes.

- Support prototype and vehicle builds, including issue triage and resolution during critical integration and test activities.

- Establish and continuously improve electrical engineering standards, design practices, documentation, and vehicle integration processes.

- Mentor electrical engineers and provide technical guidance across programs.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- Significant experience in electrical and mechanical engineering, vehicle integration, autonomous vehicles, ADAS, robotics, or advanced mobility.

- Deep understanding of vehicle electrical and electronic architectures.

- Demonstrated experience integrating complex electrical systems into development or production vehicles.

- Experience taking vehicle hardware from requirements and architecture through prototype integration, validation, and production readiness.

- Strong knowledge of:

- Vehicle power distribution and power management

- Automotive compute and ECUs

- Camera and perce

title: Product Owner, Technical - AI Neobank
description:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region - this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.
What You'll Own

• Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

• Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

• Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

• Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

• Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

• Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

• Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

• Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

• Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

• Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

• Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

• Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

• High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

• Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

• Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

• Can make decisions with incomplete information.

• Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

• Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

• Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

• People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

• PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

• Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

• People who launch features and then stop caring.

• PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Indonesia . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Indonesia.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:
1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Role-specific interview
3. CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Risk Solution Director
description:
The Risk Solutions Director is the company’s authoritative expert on clinical or program domains and is accountable for how that domain performs across the entire solution portfolio. This role focuses on the domain of Risk Adjustment across all lines of business.
The Risk Solution Director operates as a deep specialist across all segments and lines of business. This is not an SME support or technical advisory role. The Risk Solutions Director owns outcomes: domain-level product-market fit, the strength of the value narrative, and the clinical or programmatic integrity of what the company sells and delivers. It requires equal parts domain command, commercial orientation, and cross-functional influence.
Domain Strategy & Portfolio Authority

• Drive the domain roadmap. Maintain a current, prioritized view of where the domain needs to go - capabilities, depth, competitive differentiation - and translate that into actionable product input.

• Define what “good” looks like. Establish outcome standards, solution design principles, and minimum viable configurations for the domain

• Identify and close portfolio gaps. Quantify capability shortfalls that limit commercial performance, build the investment case with ROI rationale, and drive prioritization decisions with leadership.

• Own discovery, prioritization and scoping on customer feedback and requests provided via intake process, identifying thematic improvements and actioning on key requests within the domain - both customer-specific and global.

Cross-Segment Solution Design

• Run domain-level pilots and validation. Lead incubation of new domain capabilities or modules, including design of the test, success criteria, and decision framework for productization.

• Maintain cross-segment consistency. Ensure that domain solutions deployed across segments do not fragment into one-offs. Standardization of the domain layer is your accountability.

Market & Competitive Intelligence

• Own the domain value narrative. Develop and maintain the authoritative story for the domain: buyer-ready proof points and competitive differentiation.

• Own domain-level market intelligence. Track regulatory developments (e.g., ONC/CMS rule changes, CMMI program evolution), competitive moves, and buyer expectation shifts within your domain. Synthesize signal from noise and surface forward-looking implications, not just observations.

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Influence without authority. Drive alignment across Product & Technology, Sales, Customer Success, and Services on domain-related decisions. Earn trust through clarity and credibility.

• Support growth objectives as needed as a subject matter expert with domain knowledge.

Requirements

• 5+ years in healthcare SaaS, clinical services, or health plan operations, with deep expertise in Risk Adjustment.

• Direct experience at a healthcare SaaS company in a product, solutions, or strategy role with domain accountability.

• Demonstrated ownership of a domain-level strategy or product area with measurable outcomes

• Commercial orientation and experience: has operated in or closely adjacent to revenue-generating functions. Understands how the domain translates to buyer ROI and can build a value narratives independently

Preferred Skills & Experience:

• Regulatory depth: has tracked and responded to CMS rulemaking or CMMI program evolution in real time.

• Experience building or evaluating domain-specific content assets, workflows, or analytics that are embedded in customer operations at scale.

• Familiarity with both sides of the payer-provider relationship in the context of the target domain - understands how incentives and accountability are distributed across the ecosystem.

• Cross-functional influence: can name the mechanisms used to drive alignment across Product, Sales, and CS without direct authority

• Analytical discipline: defines the right domain-level metrics, tracks them, and uses data to drive investment and prioritization decis

title: Danish Life Science Linguist (Translator, Reviewer, & Editor)
description:
This is a remote position.
We are seeking a highly specialized Life Science Linguist to provide high-quality translation, revision, and editing services for technical, medical, and regulatory documents. As a 1099 contractor, you will work independently on a project-by-project basis to ensure that complex scientific content is accurately rendered into the target language while maintaining strict compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

• Translation: Convert complex life science documents (e.g., clinical trial protocols, ICFs, dossiers, and medical device manuals) from English (USA) to Danish with 100% technical accuracy.

• Review & Revision: Conduct bilingual reviews of translated materials against the source text to ensure no omissions, mistranslations, or terminology errors.

• Editing & Proofreading: Refine the style, flow, and grammar of target-language content to ensure it is culturally appropriate and meets the "native-level" quality expected for publication or regulatory submission.

• Terminology Management: Maintain and update client-specific glossaries and translation memories to ensure consistency across large-scale projects.

• QA Compliance: Adhere to ISO 17100 and ISO 13485 standards for linguistic quality and risk management.

Requirements

Qualifications & Requirements

• Education: Advanced degree (MA, MS, PhD, or MD) in a Life Science discipline (Biology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, etc.) or a degree in Translation with significant field experience.

• Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in life science translation/editing.

• Linguistic Skill: Native-level fluency in the target language and professional-level mastery of the source language.

• Technical Proficiency: Extensive experience with CAT Tools (e.g., SDL Trados, memoQ, Memsource).

• Subject Matter Expertise: Proven ability to handle high-stakes regulatory content, such as EMA/FDA filings or MedDRA/EDQM terminology.

Benefits

If you feel you meet these criteria, please apply using the form below, stating your rates for translation and your language combinations and enclosing a full CV detailing your qualifications and experience. Please note that you will be required to supply samples of recent translation work and/or take a short translation test piece. Agencies wishing to offer their services would need to provide CVs of their translators and details of their company quality assurance procedures, along with rates for translation.

Please note that if you are unable to meet the requirements above or unable to supply the required information, it will regrettably not be possible to consider your application.

title: Staff AI Engineer, GenAI
description:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.
At Teladoc Health , you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.
Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.
Job Description

Summary of Position

We are seeking an AI Engineer - Data & AI Platform to architect, build, and operationalize scalable generative AI and machine learning solutions across Snowflake, Databricks, and modern MLOps ecosystems. This role will partner with data scientists, ML engineers, and platform teams to design and deploy end-to-end AI/ML pipelines, advance AI integration, and ensure production-grade reliability for AI-driven products.

The ideal candidate has 8+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with deep expertise in generative AI deployment, API-based AI services, large-scale data processing, and AI lifecycle management. The AI Engineer will not only deliver hands-on technical solutions but also set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and drive innovation across Teladoc's AI platforms.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Operationalize GenAI and LLM applications, leveraging RAG (retrieval-augmented generation), vector search, prompt engineering, agentic AI, and MCP (Model Context Protocol).

• Lead the design, development, and deployment of production-grade LLM and ML pipelines, including data transformation, feature engineering, training, tuning, and serving.

• Architect scalable data and AI workflows on Snowflake, Databricks, and Azure ML, integrating AI models with modern data lakehouse platforms.

• Build and maintain API-based AI services (FastAPI, Flask), enabling secure, performant, and reliable model access at scale.

• Define and implement CI/CD pipelines for GenAI and ML services, using GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps, MLFlow, and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).

• Develop and enforce MLOps/LLMOps best practices, including experiment tracking, model versioning, observability, and governance.

• Mentor ML engineers and data scientists on engineering rigor, scalable design, and production-readiness.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to integrate AI services into products, ensuring security, compliance, and resilience in regulated healthcare environments.

• Troubleshoot production AI systems, analyzing inference latency, drift, and performance issues, and implementing preventive solutions.

• Document and communicate architecture patterns, operational standards, and AI development frameworks across the organization.

The time spent on each responsibility reflects an estimate and is subject to change dependent on business needs.

Supervisory Responsibilities

No

Qualifications Expected for Position

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Laser/Camera Test Engineer you will be responsible for ensuring that we are testing our systems to stringent standards ensuring that we are consistently shipping the highest quality products to our customers. In this role you’ll need to think creatively and come up with solutions to solve difficult testing problems and push to continuously improve our methods of automation, throughput, user interfaces, and data analytics. A successful candidate will be able to communicate effectively within and across teams to quickly and effectively resolve issues that arise in production.

• Collaborate with design engineers to provide feedback and recommendations for product enhancements based on test outcomes.

• Optimize test strategies for efficiency and effectiveness, reducing test time without compromising quality.

• Maintain and calibrate test equipment to ensure precision and reliability.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance testing processes and methodologies.

• 3+ years of relevant industry experience with emphasis on manufacturing test and product sustainment.

• Experience with test automation and report generation.

• Strong root cause analysis skills of non-conforming hardware, software, and firmware.

• Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal and communication skills.

• Experience working on projects that involve the integration of electrical, opto-mechanical, and software/firmware systems.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Knowledge of infrared systems, including their performance requirements and verification methodologies.

• Experience with cryogenic testing equipment.

title: Healthcare Operations Manager
description:
Raventra Health is a medical services company providing outsourced billing, coding, and claims processing solutions for provider groups and hospitals. As a Healthcare Operations Manager, you will oversee day-to-day revenue cycle operations and help ensure services are delivered accurately, efficiently, and consistently across client accounts. You will coordinate operational teams, monitor performance, resolve escalations, and identify opportunities to improve workflows and service quality.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Oversee day-to-day operations across billing, coding, claims, payment posting, and accounts receivable functions

• Coordinate workloads and priorities across operational teams to support client requirements

• Monitor productivity, quality, turnaround times, and other operational performance metrics

• Review operational reports and identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement

• Manage escalated operational issues and coordinate timely resolution with the appropriate teams

• Work with Client Success Managers to address client concerns and maintain service standards

• Develop and improve processes, procedures, and internal operating standards

• Support training, coaching, and performance development for operational team members

• Ensure teams follow established healthcare privacy, security, and compliance procedures

• Communicate operational priorities, risks, and performance updates to leadership

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• 3+ years of experience in healthcare operations, revenue cycle management, or healthcare services

• Experience managing or coordinating healthcare operations teams

• Strong understanding of revenue cycle workflows, including billing, coding, claims, payment posting, and AR

• Experience monitoring operational KPIs and using data to improve performance

• Strong leadership, organization, and problem-solving skills

• Ability to manage competing priorities and make effective operational decisions

• Strong communication skills and ability to work with both internal teams and client stakeholders

• Experience managing escalations and resolving operational issues

• Ability to work independently and effectively in a fully remote environment

• HIPAA-compliant private workspace

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience working with provider groups or hospitals

• Healthcare revenue cycle management certification

• Familiarity with Epic, Athena, eClinicalWorks, or other healthcare systems

• Lean, Six Sigma, or other process improvement experience

• Experience with outsourced healthcare services or multi-client operations

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS
Compensation will be discussed during the interview and will reflect the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant healthcare operations expertise.
Benefits and additional employment details will be discussed during the hiring process.
HIRING PROCESS
Application review → introductory conversation → hiring manager interview → offer.
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
Raventra Health is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please contact us and we will work with you to provide appropriate support.

title: Director, Global Quality Control

As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the Company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Learn more at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.

Scholar Rock is seeking an experienced and motivated Director of Global Quality Control to support commercial readiness and ongoing commercial QC operations. This role provides technical and operational leadership for commercial release and stability testing, specification lifecycle management, analytical method lifecycle activities, external laboratory oversight, and QC support for post-approval changes, regulatory commitments, and global market supply.

title: Platform Engineer - Compute Capacity
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a platform engineer to join our Compute Capacity team. This team owns the capacity plan that keeps compute supply ahead of demand across every region we operate in - the forecasting, buffer policy, and provisioning systems that make sure a project never runs into a wall it didn't know was there.

You'll work on the systems that turn a capacity plan into provisioned reality: reservation acquisition, fleet reconciliation, and the automation that keeps what we've committed to in sync with what we're actually running. You'll help build the metrics and alerting that let capacity problems surface months out, on vendor lead time, rather than at the moment someone needs the room.

You'll design, build, and operate systems that are both robust and highly automated - helping us hold the right buffer at the right cost, catch drift before it becomes a shortage, and give every team a single, trustworthy view of how much room we have across the millions of databases we manage.

WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Help build and maintain the capacity plan that keeps Supabase's compute supply ahead of demand across regions and instance families

- Support buffer policy by modeling headroom targets and their cost tradeoffs for review and sign-off

- Build and maintain automation that turns the capacity plan into provisioned reality - reservation acquisition and top-up, fleet reconciliation, drift detection between committed and running capacity

- Extend our infrastructure as code for capacity-relevant provisioning

- Instrument capacity: build and maintain metrics for saturation, reservation coverage, idle buffer, forecast error, and provisioning latency

- Build and tune capacity alerting so headroom, quota, and reservation issues surface months out rather than at the moment of impact

- Support the demand gate - helping intake large customer commitments, launches, migrations, and new regions so they reach the plan before they reach the fleet

- Contribute to mitigation projects: right-sizing, instance-family migrations, autoscaling improvements, workload consolidation

- Help drive down compute cost per database through right-sizing, placement, and commitment coverage work

- Participate in capacity incident response and post-incident follow-through

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

- Have 5+ years across infrastructure engineering, SRE, platform, or capacity engineering, ideally at SaaS or cloud infrastructure scale

- Have production software engineering experience - you've owned and operated a service, not just a notebook. Comfortable in modern languages like TypeScript, Python, and Go

- Are comfortable working against forecasts and assumptions that are incomplete, and can revise your work as those assumptions change

- Have experience with Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi or Terraform)

- Have built or maintained observability for systems you own - metrics that answer real questions and alerting people trust (Prometheus/Grafana, CloudWatch, or similar);

- Have solid working knowledge of AWS EC2: instance families and generations, purchase options, capacity reservations, and quota mechanics

- Have some financial fluency - you understand reservation economics and the basic tradeoffs between coverage, utilization, and cost

- Communicate clearly across audiences, from engineers to finance stakeholders

WHAT WE OFFER

- Fully Remote

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- ESOP

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside

title: Probabilistic Risk Assessment Engineer
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Probabilistic Risk Assessment (PRA) Engineer to join our team. 

Position Description

The Probabilistic Risk Assessment (PRA) Engineer is responsible for conducting probabilistic risk analyses to support our fast reactor design development, licensing, deployment, and operation. PRA Engineers work with our engineering teams to conduct quantitative risk analyses, including identification of initiating events (via hazards evaluation approaches such as Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEAs)), development of event trees and fault trees, quantification of event sequence probabilities, and evaluation of event sequence consequences. PRA Engineers also work with our engineering design teams to incorporate risk insights back into the design to drive improvements in reliability and safety.

Specific responsibilities may include:

• Developing probabilistic risk analysis models of our fast reactor designs

• Working with our engineering analysis teams to analyze event sequences and compile risk insights

• Using PRA techniques to evaluate external hazards

• Working with our engineering design teams to incorporate risk insights into the design and improve system reliability

• Supporting licensing activities through generation of technical reports, technical analyses, and supporting documentation

Minimum Qualifications:

• At least 5 years of work experience

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in nuclear engineering, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or similar

• Familiarity with PRA techniques

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Bonus Qualifications:

• Advanced training/education/experience in PRA

• Experience delivering products for regulatory review (DOE authorization, NRC licensing under 10 CFR Parts 50 or 52)

• Experience with PRA software (CAFTA, SAPHIRE, ADAPT, RAVEN, etc.)

• Experience with fast reactor design and analysis

• Experience with hazard analysis (FMEAs, Hazard and Operability Studies (HAZOPS), What-if Analysis)

• Experience with transient or source term analysis

• Experience with human reliability analysis

Competencies

We are looking for a PRA engineer that is:

• Passionate about clean energy 

• Passionate about making advanced fission a reality

• Willing and able to learn quickly

• Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us

• Willing to think differently and do things in new ways 

• Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment

• Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before 

• Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems

• An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!

• Able to communicate technical content and results verbally 

Who you are:

A startup person : You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated : You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At  Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”  learn more about working at Coinbase .

As an Infrastructure Lead on the Exchange team within Institutional , you'll own the network infrastructure, deployment, and operational tooling behind a unified trading platform that runs across cloud and on-prem/colocated venues. This team powers the systems that let the world's largest financial institutions trade across markets with speed, depth, and trust. You'll keep latency-sensitive, multi-node trading environments fast, reliable, and easy to build on, shaping trading infrastructure from the ground up with the ownership of a startup and the reach of Coinbase.

What you'll do:

• Own, operate, and optimize resilient, ultra-low-latency networks and physical data-center infrastructure supporting institutional trading, market data, and exchange connectivity across cloud and on-prem environments, including racking, cabling, cross-connects, and vendor coordination.

• Design and maintain routing, traffic-segmentation, and multicast market-data architectures using BGP, OSPF, VRFs, PIM, IGMP, and high-availability platforms such as Arista MLAG, Cisco vPC, and VRRP.

• Deploy and operate firewalls and secure connectivity across Fortinet and Palo Alto platforms, including IPsec VPNs, SSL VPNs, and third-party connections.

• Drive observability and operational excellence through SNMP, gRPC telemetry, latency and packet-loss analysis, microburst detection, and network automation using Python, Ansible, or similar tools.

• Lead safe production changes, incident response, failover testing, and out-of-hours maintenance for 24/7 trading systems, and participate in an on-call rotation.

• Mentor engineers and partner cross-functionally with SRE/Infra, Product, and trading-system teams to improve reliability, reduce single-point-of-failure risk, and increase developer velocity.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 8+ years of network, infrastructure, or SRE engineering experience with demonstrated ownership of production systems in financial services, electronic trading, or another latency-sensitive environment, including on-prem/colocated deployments.

• Deep hands-on expertise with multicast networking, BGP, OSPF, VRFs, high-availability architectures, low-latency data-center switching, and physical network infrastructure.

• Proven ability to lead live incident response for production trading systems, manage risk during changes, and coordinate cross-functional resolution during market events.

• Experience with Fortinet or Palo Alto firewalls, VPNs, SNMP or gRPC telemetry, network automation using Python or Ansible, and strong Linux networking fundamentals in latency-critical environments.

• Familiarity with exchange or electronic trading system concepts; deep crypto experience is a plus, not a requirement.

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

title: Staff Identity Governance and Access Engineer

description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Identity Governance and Access Security Team

The Identity Governance and Access Security team runs Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), and Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM) for Okta itself - serving as Okta's "Customer Zero." The team owns the complete identity lifecycle for the workforce, from birthright provisioning through Workday to access certifications, privileged access management, and mover/leaver processes. What the team builds becomes the reference architecture that Okta customers deploy at scale.

The Staff Identity Security Engineer Opportunity

We're looking for a Staff Identity Security Engineer to take deep technical ownership of our Okta Identity Governance (OIG), Okta Privileged Access (OPA), and ISPM implementations. This is a senior individual-contributor role where you'll set technical direction for how the team builds on top of these platforms and raise the bar for the engineering team through review, mentorship, and documentation. You should be equally comfortable in an architecture discussion, in a live Okta Workflows debugging session, and writing the design doc that a Jira epic gets broken down from. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in an autonomous environment and actively drives "what's next" for our identity security posture - identifying process bottlenecks, designing technical solutions, and pushing initiatives from concept to production without waiting for direction.

What you'll be doing

• OIG Architecture Ownership: Own OIG architecture end-to-end - design access request workflows, entitlement/Resource Collections structures, and certification campaigns that reduce reviewer fatigue and rubber-stamping.

• Lifecycle, Birthright & RBAC Strategy: Lead lifecycle, birthright, and RBAC strategy - design and deploy automated birthright access rules, RBAC frameworks, and seamless joiner/mover/leaver (JML) processes across the enterprise.

• Workday Integration Architecture: Drive Workday integration architecture - balance scheduled reconciliation (attribute accuracy) with Real-Time Sync (immediate termination), and define the attribute sets that access rules depend on.

• Mover/Leaver Automation: Design and harden mover/leaver automation - implement attribute-driven group re-evaluation on role changes, safe decommissioning of stale access, and close gaps between automated joiner flows and historically manual processes.

• OPA, ISPM & Zero Standing Privilege: Lead OPA, ISPM, and Zero Standing Privilege (ZSP) initiatives - design privileged session access, Just-In-Time (JIT) elevation, break-glass emergency access, identity security vulnerability detection, and tiering models for Tier 0/Tier 1 systems.

• PAM & ISPM Metrics: Own PAM and ISPM telemetry and KPIs - establish and track metrics around standing-privilege reduction, JIT adoption, stale access cleanup, and break-glass test success as ongoing operational measures.

• Okta Workflows Automation: Build and maintain Okta Workflows automation - streamline access requests, approvals, and remediation across IGA and PAM processes using the Okta Workflows engine.

• Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Mentor engineers, review designs, and communicate with leadership - be the technical escalation point for the team's hardest problems, help junior engineers grow, and present clear updates, risk assessments, and roadmaps to executive stakeholders.

title: Software Architecture - Sr Advisor I
description:
Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv .
We’re Fiserv , a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv .
Job Title
Software Architecture - Sr Advisor I Role Overview
Finxact is an innovative, enterprise-class, 100 percent open API, cloud-native banking platform and transaction processing engine. It is designed to support banking, fintech, and embedded finance organizations with a highly scalable, resilient, and adaptable technology platform.
We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer - Event Messaging to provide technical leadership in the design, development, and evolution of Finxact’s event-driven platform and messaging capabilities.
This role combines hands-on software engineering with architecture and technical leadership across highly distributed, event-driven systems. You will help define and implement scalable messaging patterns and services using Golang, Apache Kafka, Kubernetes, REST, gRPC, and cloud-native technologies.
You will work across engineering teams to improve the reliability, scalability, performance, and operability of our eventing platform while establishing architectural standards and engineering practices for asynchronous communication. Experience with change data capture technologies, including CDC and Debezium, is highly valuable for this role.
Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and evolve highly scalable, resilient, and maintainable event-driven services and messaging platform capabilities.

• Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance for distributed systems and event-driven application architectures.

• Develop production services and platform components using Golang.

• Design and implement scalable event streaming and messaging solutions using Apache Kafka.

• Define architectural patterns and engineering standards for producers, consumers, topics, schemas, event contracts, retries, error handling, and message processing.

• Design solutions that account for ordering, delivery guarantees, idempotency, backpressure, failure recovery, and distributed-system failure scenarios.

• Develop APIs and supporting services using REST and gRPC where appropriate.

• Collaborate with application, platform, database, and architecture teams to integrate event-driven capabilities across the Finxact platform.

• Design, deploy, and operate containerized services within Kubernetes environments.

• Develop and improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation to support reliable and repeatable delivery of messaging services.

• Analyze performance, scalability, and reliability characteristics of event-driven systems and identify opportunities for improvement.

• Troubleshoot complex production issues involving event processing, service communication, Kafka, databases, and distributed systems.

• Establish observability practices for messaging platforms, including metrics, logging, tracing, lag monitoring, and operational alerting.

• Participate in architecture reviews, technical design sessions, code reviews, and performance analysis.

• Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance on Golang, Kafka, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and cloud-native development.

• Influence technical direction across teams and drive consistency in messaging architecture and engineering practices.

Required Qualifications

• 7+ years of professional software development experience designing, developing, and supporting production software systems.

• Significant experience with software architecture, technical design, and technical leadership for complex distributed systems.

• 5+ years of Golang

title: Director, Customer Compensation & Policy
description:
About the Role 

Within Global Customer Experience (GCX), our mission is to advance the HelloFresh customer relationship from reactive resolution to proactive, trust-building service. The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay.

The Associate Director, Customer Compensation & Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence.

You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust.

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination: analytical rigor sharp enough to architect a global compensation engine from first principles, and the executive presence to drive adoption across a complex, multi-market organization without formal authority over most of the people they need to move.

What You'll Own 

 Global Compensation Strategy & Engine Architecture

• Own the end-to-end strategic vision for how HelloFresh categorizes customer errors and determines compensation across all markets, brands, and contact channels.

• Lead the design and continuous evolution of the compensation engine: along with Tech, you’ll define the the rules, thresholds, segmentation logic, and automation frameworks that govern recovery decisions at scale.

• Define the principles that govern trade-offs between customer generosity and cost discipline and translate those principles into operational rules that hold across market complexity and brand variation.

• Partner with Technology to ensure the compensation engine is scalable, auditable, and capable of supporting dynamic, AI-assisted decisioning as the product evolves.

Experimentation & Behavioral Economics

• Set the global roadmap for compensation experimentation: A/B testing across offer types, value levels, channel timing, and segmentation variables.

• Apply behavioral economics frameworks to compensation design understanding how recovery offers shape long-term retention, repurchase behavior, and brand perception, not just immediate satisfaction.

• Define the measurement framework for experimentation: what constitutes a successful test, what confidence warrants global rollout, and how results are synthesized into durable policy change.

• Partner with Analytics & Insights to ensure test design, sample integrity, and rollout analysis meet a rigorous standard of evidence.

Financial Stewardship & Cost Governance

• Own the global compensation P&L line: tracking spend by market, error category, customer segment, and channel - and holding yourself accountable to defined cost-per-incident and avoidable-contact targets.

• Identify and close financial leakage: cases where compensation is being issued without policy justification, at incorrect values, or at the wrong frequency.

• Build the reporting infrastructure that makes compensation economics visible to GCX leadership, market GMs, and Finance - with the granularity and context needed to drive decisions.

• Define the right balance between cost optimization and customer lifetime value investment: not just 'spend less' but 'spend where it earns back.

Fraud Policy & Global Governance

• Own the global fraud and abuse prevention framework: the policies, detection logic, thresholds, and escalation paths that protect the business without creating friction for genuine customers.

• Thrive in autonomy and enjoy taking responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks

• Use AI as a core part of how you think, build, and make decisions, not just a productivity aid

• Value simplicity, testability, and fast feedback

title: Product Manager, Infrastructure
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We're hiring a Product Manager to own prioritization and roadmap for Benchling’s core infrastructure teams. You'll turn engineering constraints, customer pain, and business priorities into a clear, defensible roadmap and you'll make the prioritization calls, with the support of the team, to stay focused on the highest-impact work. Success comes from helping the business understand infrastructure constraints and opportunities, and on the other side helping the infrastructure teams stay connected to business to better anticipate future needs and make strategic long-term investments.

You are not expected to be a systems architect or write technical designs but you're expected to understand infrastructure well enough that you can work with engineering to make crisp trade-off calls under incomplete information.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the infra direction. Convert recurring engineering pain, customer requests, and business priorities into a prioritized, outcome-focused roadmap and product direction with clear rationale for what's in and what's out.

- Customer discovery. Find the latent infrastructure needs inside Benchling's engineering teams and talk to external customers about scale, performance, and technical direction.

- Make and hold prioritization calls. When priorities conflict, you can explain the tradeoff to both engineering and executive stakeholders.

- Build the business case. Translate infrastructure investment into terms the rest of the organization can act on.

- Define requirements, not designs. Define the problems to solve and provide as much context as you can without dictating the technical solution so that engineering can build against it.

- Coordinate across orgs. Represent infra priorities to dependent teams and represent dependent-team needs back into the infra roadmap. Program management is required and is a shared responsibility with your engineering manager counterpart.

- Report on outcomes. Define the handful of metrics that matter for this area (reliability, cost, adoption, developer time saved, just to name a few) and hold the roadmap accountable to them.

- Partner on cloud economics - Partner with Engineering, Finance, Security, and Procurement on cloud economics and strategic infrastructure investments, including spend forecasting, cost optimization, commitments, credits and incentive programs, vendor roadmaps, and evaluating new capabilities.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

- 6+ years of product management experience, with direct exposure to infrastructure, platform, or developer-facing systems.

- A track record of making real prioritization calls under pressure, not just facilitating consensus. You can describe a time you said no

title: Senior Python Software Engineer/Open-Source Contributor - EMEA Remote
description:
At Hugging Face , we're on a journey to democratize good AI. We are building the fastest growing platform for AI builders with over 11 million users who collectively shared over 4 million models, 1 million datasets & 1.5 million Gradio apps. Our open-source libraries have more than 700,000 stars on Github.

About the Role
Roles at Hugging Face are very fluid and dynamic - we are looking for someone who is comfortable taking on different challenges that will evolve over time.
You'll join the Applications team, whose goal is to build the tooling that helps developers create machine learning applications on top of the primitives we offer on the Hub: Gradio, Spaces, Inference Providers, Datasets, Xet, and more. Concretely, that means maintaining and growing libraries like Trackio, a local-first, agent-friendly experiment tracking platform, FastRTC, our library for real-time audio and video streaming in Python, and Gradio itself, used by more than 1 million developers each month. These tools have made machine learning accessible to a wide audience - for the first time in history, anyone with an internet connection can use cutting-edge models right from their browser.
Several of these libraries are still early in their life, and new ones will start from scratch. A large part of this role is taking a project from its first users to widespread adoption: shaping the API, shipping fast, and getting it into developers' hands.
Key responsibilities include:

• Designing, developing, and maintaining core features across the team's libraries, ensuring scalability, reliability, and ease of use for ML developers.

• Architecting complex Python projects and frameworks that serve as foundational tools for the ML community.

• Growing early-stage libraries: defining the API surface, writing the demos and documentation that make them click, and driving adoption in the developer community.

• Working on real-time streaming and networking capabilities, a core priority for Gradio 7 and beyond.

• Collaborating with open-source contributors and engaging with the broader community through code reviews, discussions, and support.

• Integrating modern frontend technologies to create seamless and intuitive user experiences for Python-based web applications.

• Adapting to evolving engineering challenges and contributing to the direction of our developer tools as the landscape changes.

Requirements
About You
If you love open-source, are passionate about making machine learning more accessible, have experience building Python frameworks, and want to contribute to some of the fastest-growing libraries in the ML ecosystem, then we can't wait to see your application!
What you'll need

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field

• 5+ years of professional Python development experience

• Experience architecting complex Python projects or frameworks

• A track record of taking early-stage libraries or products from first users to broad adoption

• Professional experience with JavaScript or TypeScript

• Professional experience with a modern frontend framework such as React or Svelte

• Experience core-contributing to or maintaining open-source software projects

Nice to have

• Experience with real-time audio/video streaming or networking (WebRTC, WebSockets)

• Contributions to libraries such as pipecat, LiveKit, FastAPI, or Starlette

If you're interested in joining us, but don't tick every box above, we still encourage you to apply! We're building a diverse team whose skills, experiences, and backgrounds complement one another. We're happy to consider where you might be able to make the biggest impact.
One more thing
At Hugging Face we believe great AI shouldn't require a massive cluster, we build for everyone, especially the GPU-poor. And because we read every application, here's a small sign that you read this one too: start your answer to the first application question with the words “ GPU-poor and proud 🤗”. No trick, no cat

Strong understanding of technical drawings, engineering deliverables, and procurement packages.

title: Data Scientist - Client Platform

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord is where millions of people hang out every day - 90% of them play games, spending over 5 billion hours across thousands of titles each month. We are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to talk and hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our Client Platform Data Science team, where you’ll help make sure that Discord just works. You’ll partner with the teams that design, build, and support Discord - improving app performance, enhancing the user experience, and driving growth. Your work will span strategic analyses, experimentation, and dashboarding. Specifically, we’re looking for someone who can help us take Discord’s mobile and desktop reliability to the next level through better metrics, monitoring, and automation.

If you’re passionate about data and want to make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you!

What you'll be doing

• Partner with teams throughout Discord through the full analytics lifecycle - from exploratory analyses to dashboards, reports, and A/B testing

• Define KPIs and diagnostic metrics that improve the user experience, and build dashboards to make them timely and actionable

• Build custom datasets to monitor novel product features and processes

• Share insights with technical and non-technical audiences, and iterate based on feedback

• Champion A/B testing best practices - helping teams design, analyze, and interpret experiments correctly

• Collaborate with data and engineering teams to design scalable and future-proof instrumentation and self-serve tooling

What you should have

• 2+ years of hands-on analytics experience turning ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable insights

• Experience designing, analyzing, and interpreting A/B tests at scale

• Strong SQL skills and experience building clean, performant dashboards (Tableau, Looker, or similar)

• Clear communication skills, with the ability to make complex findings easy to understand

• Curiosity, a collaborative attitude, and a drive to solve hard problems

Bonus Points

• Passion for Discord or online communities

• Experience with performance/reliability analytics for online services

• Familiarity with social or subscription products (social graphs, LTV, funnel analysis)

• Production ETL or BigQuery experience

• Experience using AI in data science work

Operating in small, innovative teams, we push the boundaries of what's possible to deliver advanced technologies with mission-critical applications. Our commitment doesn't end with academic research or proof-of-concept experiments; we measure our success by the real-world impact of our deployed solutions. Inspired by Arthur C. Clarke's vision - “Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic” - we aim to achieve groundbreaking results in path planning, route optimization, and autonomous mission execution at the command and control layer. • Integrate path planning technologies into the broader command and control software stack and development lifecycle, from requirements definition through testing and optimization.

• Translate technical progress into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders, including colleagues, operators, and end-users.

• 3+ years of experience in algorithm design, software development, and mathematical modeling with programming expertise in C/C++ and/or Rust.

At Sysdig, we believe cloud security isn't a compromise - it's a promise. From the start, our mission has been clear: to help organizations secure innovation in the cloud, the right way.
 
We created Falco, the open standard for cloud threat detection, and continue to lead the cloud security market with runtime insights, open innovation, and agentic Al. Creators of technology trusted by over 60% of the Fortune 500, Sysdig gives teams the real-time clarity to move fast and defend what matters most.
 
Culture matters here. We believe diversity fuels stronger ideas, and open dialogue drives sharper decisions. Recognized as a Best Place to Work and one of Deloitte's fastest-growing companies for the past 5 years, we're here to raise the standard for what cloud security and workplace culture should be.
 
If you have the passion to dig deeper, the desire to challenge convention, and the curiosity to build something better, Sysdig is the right place for you.

The annual compensation range for this full-time position is between €XX,XXX and €XX,XXX. Actual offers may be higher or lower than this range based on a variety of factors, including your work location, job-related experience and education.
The national collective bargaining agreement (CCNL) applied by Sysdig is CCNL Terziario-Confcommercio.
 
We would love for you to join us! Please reach out even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description. We can always explore other options after starting the conversation. Your background and passion will set you apart, especially if your career path is different.
 
Sysdig values a diverse workplace and encourages women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign-born residents, and veterans to apply. Sysdig is an equal-opportunity employer. Sysdig does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected status.

title: Leadership Program (MBA Graduate)
Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW) - Corpus Christi, TX
description:
Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LCSW/LMFT/LMHC) 60 K-75K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Corpus Christi, TX

Salary:

60K - 75K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

• No extra "on call" work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

• Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.

• Typically, clinicians work between Mondays - Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM.
